text.body:
% @##/ /rgya gar skad du/ karma an+ta bi b+ha ng+ga nA ma/ bod skad du/ las kyi mtha' rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /
thog ma dbus mtha' spangs pa yi/ /stong pa bzhi la phyag 'tshal nas/ /thams cad dag cing rnam dag pa'i/ /rim pa'i dbye bas nges sbyar bya/ /ye shes rnam gsum las byung ba/ /khams bzhi dang ni dbang po drug / phung po lnga dang sgo dgu dang / /'gro ba gsum po phal cher ni/ /skye gnas rnam pa bzhi yin te/ /sgong skyes dang ni mngal skyes dang /
/drod gsher skyes ni gsum pa yin/ /bzhi pa yang ni rdzus skyes so/ /thog med sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ /rnam shes gsum po bsgoms pas ni/ /dus gsum du ni spyad pa'i las/ /rnam shes gsum gyi rgyu can no/ /ye shes gsum po zhes brjod pa/ /de yang snang ba tsam nyid de/ /dang po ma rig shes par bya/ /gnyis pa de bzhin sems las byung /
/gsum pa sems zhes bya 'di rnams/ / stong nyid gsum du brjod pa yin/ /stong nyid gsum las byung ba'i rlung / /de nyid dang ni kun du gnas/ /de yi bzhon pa nyid 'gyur te/ /bdag nyid kyang ni stong pa'i phyir/ /rnam shes las ni rlung 'byung ste/ /de las me ni yang dag 'byung / /de las chu ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de las yang ni sa 'byung ngo / /
146a
de rnams las ni phung po 'byung / /de las yang ni skye mched 'byung / /de las ye shes rang bzhin rnams/ /brgya ni drug cu dang bcas slar/ /skad cig 'dod chags bral dang 'jigs/ /la lar mya ngan zhi ba nyid/ /la lar byams dang snying rje dang / /so sor rtog dang yid gang dang / /la lar sred pa rnam rtog dang / /rig bya rig dang ngo tsha shes/
/dal dang mi dge rang bzhin med/ /nye bar len dang sogs pa dang / /la lar bkres skom ser sna dang / /la lar dogs dang tshor pa ste/ /sems kyi rang bzhin 'di rnams ni/ /snang ba'i ye shes rgyu can no/ /skad cig 'dod chags de bzhin dga'/ /la lar gdug pa nus pa dang / /la lar nga rgyal de bzhin spro/ /la lar rangs pa btsan thabs 'gar/
/la lar brtan dang stobs can nyid/ /la lar ngag ni gsal bar 'gyur/ /la lar bden dang mi bden dang / / la lar spro byed byed po yang / /la lar dpa' bo brtson 'grus dang / /ngo tsha med dang bskul ba 'gar/ /'gar yang ngo mtshar drag po dang / /zhe 'gras sbyin pa po nyid dang / /mi srun pa nyid gya gyu nyid/ /rnam par sgeg pa'ang sems las byung /
/brjed ngas pa dang la lar 'khrul/ /la lar rnam par g.yeng ba nyid/ /le lo nyid dang la lar ngal/ /la lar mi smra'i dngos por 'gyur/ /la lar the tshom nyid shes bya/ /ma rig pa yi dus su 'byung / /ye shes rang bzhin 'di rnams ni/ /lnga bcu rtsa bzhi dag tu bshad/ /
pṛthagbhāve caturṇāṃ ca gate skandhe tathendriye ||
% mtshan mo nyin mo'i dbye ba yis/ /yang nas yang du rab tu 'jug /bzhi rnams so so'i dor son pa/ de bzhin phung po dbang po la'o/ /
krameṇānena līyante yathaivāgamanaṃ purā |
prāṅ mahī salilaṃ gacchej jalaṃ gacchati pāvakam ||
% sngon ni ji ltar 'ongs pa bzhin/ /rim pa 'di yis thim 'gyur te/ /dang po sa ni chu la 'jug /chu ni me la thim 'gyur zhing / /
pāvako vāyum anveti vāyur vijñānam āviśet |
vijñānaṃ dhāraṇaṃ gatvā prabhāsvaram athāviśet ||
% me ni rlung la thim par 'gyur/ / rlung ni rnam par shes la 'jug /rnam shes 'dzin par gshegs nas su/ /'od gsal bar ni de nas zhugs/ /
tasmād gandharvatāṃ gatvā jāyate karmacoditaḥ |
% Tanaka: karmacoditam
evaṃ janmasamudreṣu bhūtvā bhūtvā punaḥ punaḥ ||
% Tib. *janmasahasreṣu
% de las dri za nyid gyur nas/ /las kyis bskul las skye bar 'gyur/ /de ltar skye ba stong rnams su/ /skyes shing skyes nas yang dang yang / /
prakṛtyāvartasaṃbhrāmāt pāraṃ na labhate jagat |
ābhāsasya parijñānaṃ tārkikāṇām agocaram ||
% rang bzhin 146b bskor zhing kun du 'khrul/ /rtog ge rnams kyi yul min la/ /snang ba yongs su shes pa ni/ /'gro bas ma rnyed bar du'o/ /
ābhāsamīlanaṃ cāpi punar atyantadurlabham |
rajas tamaś ca sattvaṃ cety evaṃ saṃkalpyate paraiḥ ||
% snang ba rnyed pa dag kyang ni/ /slar yang rnyed pa shin tu dka'/ /rdul dang mun pa snying stobs shes/ /'di ni gzhan gyis kun du brtags/ /
ābhāsatrayam evaitat svābhāvajñānahāṇitaḥ |
% anne svabhāva°
bhavanirvāṇahetuś ca jñānatrayam idaṃ matam ||
% snang ba gsum po 'di nyid kyi/ /rang bzhin shes pa spangs pa'i phyir/ /srid dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu/ /ye shes gsum po 'di ru bzhed/ /
ābhāsaprakṛtīr yatra sthānaṃ tat puṇyapāpayoḥ |
% anne °prakṛtir?
% tat ] \emend, tatra Tanaka
ābhāsatrayaśuddhasya niyataṃ saugataṃ padam ||
% saugataṃ padam ] \emend, saugatapadaṃ Tanaka
% snang ba'i rang bzhin gang du gnas/ /de ru sdig dang bsod nams dag /snang ba gsum po dag pa ni/ /nges par bde bar gshegs pa'i gnas/ /
brahmā viṣṇuś ca rudraś ca ye cānye kapilādayaḥ |
prakṛtyābhāsasaṃmūḍhā viśuddhau cāpi sarvathā ||
% tshangs pa khyab 'jug drag po dang / /gang gzhan ser skya la sogs rnams/ /rang bzhin snang ba kun du rmongs/ /rnam dag la yang rnam kun du/ /
bskal pa mtha' yas rnams su yang / /mgo dang rin chen sogs sbyin pas/ /snang ba rnam par ma dag na/ /byang chub 'bras bu thob mi 'gyur/ /mtha' yas bskal pa rnams su yang / /de bzhin tshul khrims bzod sogs kyis/ /snang ba rnam par ma dag na/ /byang chub 'bras bu thob mi 'gyur/ /mtha' yas bskal pa rnams su yang / /sngags kyi sku yi ting 'dzin gyis/
/snang ba rnam par ma dag na/ /byang chub 'bras bu thob mi 'gyur/ /snang ba gsum po dag pa ni/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid the tshom med/ /bla ma brgyud pa'i rim nyid kyis/ /de ni thob 'gyur gzhan gyis min/ /sprin ni 'brug sgra'i rnam pa dang ldan nam/ /nam mkha'i khong nas kun du 'byung ba rnams/ /phyogs bcu bskor nas gnas shing de nyid du/
/slar yang yal bar mthong ba ji lta ba/ /de ltar rnam shes rnams ni 'od gsal gnas las 'thon zhing slar yang zhig gyur nas/ /rang bzhin rnam pa sna tshogs rnams su gnas shing de nyid du ni yal bar 'gyur/ /las kyi mtha' rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba rje btsun 'phags pa klu'i blo'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //
rgya gar gyi mkhan po bla ma rje btsun ma Ni ka shrI dz+nyA na dang / bla ma rje btsun chen po re ben+te'i zhal snga nas gus par mnyan nas chag lo tsA ba shAkya'i dge slong chos rje dpal gyis bsgyur cing zhus te 147a
gtan la phab pa'o/ /
